title: Best Time to Buy And Sell Stock II
summary: Find the largest profit from trading one share at a time across the listed days.
statement: Find the largest profit from trading one share at a time across the listed days. You may complete multiple trades and may sell and buy on the same day. Begin and end without a share.

examples.explanation: Do not trade on a falling sequence.

hints: Conceptual: Holding through a fall is optional.
Directional: An increasing run can be split into adjacent gains without changing its profit.
Implementation: Sum every positive difference between consecutive prices.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
